title: Pod stuck in CrashLoopBackOff
symptoms: Back-off restarting failed container. Pod status CrashLoopBackOff with restart count rising. Container exits right after start with an error in its last log lines.
root_cause: The container crashes on startup: bad config or missing secret, failing migration, or a dependency it cannot reach.
impact: The service has fewer or zero healthy replicas; requests may fail.
fix_steps: Read the crash output: kubectl logs <pod> --previous.
Check recent config, secret and image changes.
Roll back the deployment: kubectl rollout undo deployment/<name>.
prevention: Use readiness probes, validate config in CI, and use canary deploys.
